question: What different outcomes are possible for the awakening of the knowledge-non-whole being?
premises: The jñānākala can awaken to the status of mantra-lord or great lord.
The jñānākala can awaken to mantra-level status.
The jñānākala can sometimes awaken even toward worldly existence.
inference: The awakening of the jñānākala admits multiple possible outcomes, including higher lordship and, in some cases, worldly existence.
uncertainties: The conditions that determine which outcome occurs are not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Even the knowledge-non-whole being may awaken to the status of mantra-lord or great lord, or to mantra-level status, and sometimes even to worldly existence.
